slides.title: Be able to, be allowed to, need to, ought to
slides.subtitle: Semi-modals for ability, permission and necessity
goals: Use semi-modals in tenses where *can / must* don't work.
Talk about permission with **be allowed to**.

slides.title: Meanings

head: Form
Meaning
Example
rows: I **won't be able to** come tomorrow.

slides.tip: *Can* has no future or perfect form: say *I'll be able to*, *I've been able to*.

items.q: I ___ swim since I was five.
You ___ pay now. You can pay later.

items.t: Will you ___ able to help me tomorrow?
Were you ___ to go out late when you were 15?
